scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: Your private library and learning history. Cloudflare creates a new D1 database for this installation; keep the binding name `DB`.

APP_URL.description: The exact public HTTPS origin, with no path, such as `https://tenbrains.your-subdomain.workers.dev`. If unknown, update it in Worker Settings after deployment and before signing in. Do not use localhost in production.

OWNER_X_ID.description: Your numeric X account ID, not your @handle. Only this account can sign in.

X_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID from your confidential Web App in the [X developer console](https://console.x.com/). Register `APP_URL/auth/callback` as its callback.

X_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret from the same X Web App. Enable read-only permissions, not writes.

SESSION_SECRET.description: A new cryptographically random secret of at least 32 characters. Generate one locally with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep it stable across deployments.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Optional separate random secret for X token encryption. Leave blank to derive encryption from SESSION_SECRET. Changing it requires signing in again.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Your [Groq API key](https://console.groq.com/keys), used only for explicit learning, analysis, import, and grading actions.

GROQ_MODEL.description: Optional model supporting Groq strict structured outputs. Defaults to `openai/gpt-oss-20b`.
